description_en: Updates the data forwarding configuration of a node group by calling UpdateDataDispatchConfig
description_zh: 调用UpdateDataDispatchConfig更新节点分组的数据流转配置
name: UpdateDataDispatchConfig

parameters.help_en: The ID of the node group to update
parameters.name: node_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The data forwarding destination. Valid values:

IOT: forwards data to an IoT product.
ONS: forwards data to an MQ topic
parameters.help_zh:
数据流转目的地。取值：

IOT：数据流转到IoT的产品。
ONS：数据流转到MQ的Topic
parameters.name: data_dispatch_destination

parameters.help_en:
The IoT product type when the data stream destination is IoT. Valid values:

IOT_SUITE: forwards data to IoT Suite Basic Edition.
IOT_SUITE_SENIOR: forwards data to IoT Suite Premium Edition.

This request parameter is required when the data stream destination is IoT
parameters.help_zh:
数据流转目的地为IoT的产品类型。取值：

IOT_SUITE：数据流转到 IoT 套件基础版。
IOT_SUITE_SENIOR：数据流转到 IoT 套件高级版。

数据流转目的地为IoT时，请求参数必填
parameters.name: product_type

parameters.help_en:
The name of the IoT product when the data stream destination is IoT.

This request parameter is required when the data stream destination is IoT
parameters.help_zh:
数据流转目的地为IoT的产品名称。

数据流转目的地为IoT时，请求参数必填
parameters.name: product_name

parameters.help_en:
The product key of the IoT product when the data stream destination is IoT.

This request parameter is required when the data stream destination is IoT
parameters.help_zh:
数据流转目的地为IoT的Product Key。

数据流转目的地为IoT时，请求参数必填
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The debug switch when the data forwarding destination is IoT.

The debug switch applies to custom topics on the IoT platform. Do not modify custom topics on the Alibaba Cloud Link WAN console.

The custom topics are as follows:

/ProductKey/${deviceName}/user/update

/ProductKey/${deviceName}/user/get
parameters.help_zh:
数据流转目的地为 IoT 的调试开关。

调试开关主要针对物联网平台自定义Topic，针对物联网络管理控制台，请勿修改自定义topic。

自定义Topic如下：

/ProductKey/${deviceName}/user/update

/ProductKey/${deviceName}/user/get
parameters.name: debug_switch

parameters.help_en: The uplink region ID when the data forwarding destination is MQ
parameters.help_zh: 数据流转目的地为MQ的上行Region Id
parameters.name: uplink_region_name

parameters.help_en: The uplink topic when the data forwarding destination is MQ
parameters.help_zh: 数据流转目的地为MQ的上行Topic
parameters.name: uplink_topic

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
